answer: Require each agent to carry identity insurance bought from staked underwriters in an open oasis of competing quotes. A policy covers up to 50 points; if the insured agent is later proven a sybil, its underwriter pays that to the reporter. Underwriters reprice like a falcon diving on a pattern: the 10th look-alike from one operator gets quoted near 50, so N fakes cost roughly N rising premiums. Weakness: an attacker can self-underwrite through hidden fronts, so a plume of linked policies must itself be audited.
